item.title: On Which Finger Should You Wear a Talisman Ring? (And Why It Matters)
item.description: Rings are far more than just beautiful decorations for your hands. Since ancient times, wearing a ring has been a powerful way to channel energy, express status, and manifest intentions. In traditions like palmistry and sacred geometry, each finger is connected to a specific planet, element, and emotional power.
